provision.title: Step 1: Create the community
provision.description: Create the new community with its address, its name and its first admin.
provision.failed: The community could not be created. Please try again.

slug.label: Address (slug)
slug.hint: 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter.

name.label: Name
name.hint: The community's internal name, up to 80 characters.

displayName.label: Display name
displayName.hint: The name members see. Leave empty to use the name.

adminEmail.label: Admin email
adminEmail.hint: This person becomes the community's first admin.

allMembersGroupName.label: All-members group name
allMembersGroupName.hint: Every new member joins this group automatically.

defaultLocale.label: Default language
defaultLocale.hint: Language code, for example de or en.

enabledLocales.label: Enabled languages
enabledLocales.hint: Comma-separated language codes, for example de, en (at most 20).

currency.label: Currency
currency.hint: ISO 4217 code in upper case, for example EUR.

jevBudget.label: Monthly Jev budget (USD)
jevBudget.hint: Between 0 and 500 USD. Leave empty for the default.

brandPack.title: Step 2: Brand pack
brandPack.description: Set the community's colours, sender and landing page. Only the fields you fill in are saved.
brandPack.colorsHint: Hex values like #1A2B3C. If you set one colour, set all three.
brandPack.overrideExplanation: The community is not ready for open sign-up yet. To open it anyway, give a reason – or switch open sign-up off again.
brandPack.personaHint: Short facts Vitana should know about the community – no finished sentences.
brandPack.failed: The brand pack could not be saved. Please try again.

legalEntityLine.label: Legal entity line
legalEntityLine.hint: The line naming the legal entity, for example in emails and the imprint.

landingCta.label: Landing page action
landingCta.hint: What visitors can do on the community's landing page.

openSignup.label: Open sign-up
openSignup.hint: Anyone can sign up without an invitation. Off by default.

communityPronunciation.label: Name pronunciation
communityPronunciation.hint: How Vitana should pronounce the name.

storyFacts.label: Story facts
storyFacts.hint: One fact per line, at most 8.

offerFacts.label: Offer facts
offerFacts.hint: One fact per line, at most 8.

tone.label: Tone
tone.hint: One keyword per line, at most 8, for example warm.

assets.title: Upload images
assets.description: Choose a file for each image and upload it with the button.

logo.label: Logo
logo.hint: Shown in the app and in emails.

favicon.label: Favicon
favicon.hint: The small icon in the browser tab.

og_image.label: Link preview image
og_image.hint: Appears when someone shares a link to the community.

assets.uploadFailed: The upload didn't work. Please try again.
assets.invalidType: This file can't be used. Please choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

validation.slugLength: The slug must be 3 to 32 characters long.
validation.slugFormat: Only lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens; start with a letter.
validation.slugReserved: This address is reserved for the platform. Please choose another one.
validation.email: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.hexColor: Please enter a colour in the format #RRGGBB.
validation.budgetRange: Please enter an amount between 0 and 500.
validation.locale: Please enter a valid language code, for example de.
validation.localeList: Please enter up to 20 valid language codes, separated by commas.
validation.currency: Please enter a three-letter currency code in upper case, for example EUR.
validation.factTooLong: Each fact can be at most 200 characters long.
validation.anchorNameRequired: Please enter the anchor person's name.
validation.overrideReasonLength: The reason must be 10 to 500 characters long.
validation.nothingToUpdate: Fill in at least one field before saving.

panel.title: New community
panel.description: Create a new community in three steps: basics, brand, then images and readiness.

readiness.title: Readiness
readiness.ready: All set – the community can be opened.
readiness.schemaMissing: Provisioning is not available for this community yet.
readiness.legacy: Existing community – some items apply only partly.
